name: macha-client

scripts.build-samsung: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode samsung
scripts.build:web-android: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode android
scripts.build-android: npm run build:web-android && platforms/android/gradlew -p platforms/android assembleDebug stageDeploymentApk
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json --pretty false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --pretty false

description: Small React/TypeScript web and TV client for Macha.
